name: Arrange Mounting Holes
description: Arrange selected mounting holes on a grid (columns x rows) with exact X/Y spacing. Live preview included.
description_full:
Moves the SELECTED mounting-hole footprints onto a clean grid (columns x rows) with exact X/Y spacing, e.g. 4 holes on a 40 x 40 mm rectangle or 6 holes on a 2 x 3 grid. Nothing is duplicated and nothing is aligned to edge cuts — the holes are simply snapped to the grid positions of a centered rectangle.

Features:
- Live preview: grey dots are the holes' current positions, coloured boxes are the target grid points, each labelled with the reference that will land there
- Columns/Rows freely adjustable (defaults: factors closest to a square, oriented to the selection's bounding box)
- X/Y spacing in mm (defaults measured from the selection)
- Each hole moves to its nearest free grid point
- Optional: group the footprints after placing so they stay together as one movable unit (skipped automatically if they are already grouped)
- Normal edit operation, undoable with Ctrl+Z

Usage: select the mounting holes in the PCB editor, then run Tools -> External Plugins -> Arrange Mounting Holes.
